text:
emma_cs: Heads up - Goldcrest Health launching APAC pilot tomorrow. They need a short-lived regional egress/peering + per-route rate bump for the /v1/generate route.
ryan_ops: Got it. Rough numbers? window?
emma_cs: Expected peak ~85 qps for ~2 hours, sustained ~18 qps for 6 hours. Preferred window: 2026-03-22 01:00-07:00 UTC. Auto-revoke after 48h.
sam_gce: Account ID: acct_GC_9982. Contact: liam@goldcrest.health (on-call during launch). Route is tagged prod/goldcrest/v1/generate. Model pinned to rw-instruct-3-small.
ryan_ops: Thanks. We'll target a soft cap of 100 qps on that route and enable burst to 150 qps for 5m sliding window. We'll also add IP allowlist for their NAT egress ranges - please confirm IPs.
emma_cs: Confirming IPs: 34.88.12.0/24, 35.190.45.0/24, plus peering via ap-southeast-1. Also want header-based allowlist on X-GC-Auth for their proxy.
tilly_infra: I can provision peering and update the allowlist. Two quick asks: 1) do you want the change applied to both edge and origin? 2) should we create a canary route first?
emma_cs: Apply to edge only first (ap-southeast-1 edges). Canary not needed - it's a customer-requested burst. Please set an automatic rollback if errors >2% for 10m.
tilly_infra: Understood. I'll push a config patch. Sample control-plane snippet I'm going to apply:
```
{
  "account": "acct_GC_9982",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "region": "ap-southeast-1",
  "allowlist_ips": ["34.88.12.0/24","35.190.45.0/24"],
  "header_whitelist": {"X-GC-Auth": "present"},
  "rate_limits": {"sustained_qps": 20, "soft_cap_qps": 100, "burst_qps": 150},
  "auto_revoke_after": "48h",
  "rollback_on_error_pct": "2%",
  "note": "Goldcrest APAC pilot launch - temp bump"
}
```
ryan_ops: I'll create a ticket and attach the patch. tagging @deploy-bot for deploy to staging then prod if staging looks good.
deploy-bot: staging deployment queued for config-id cfg_gc_2409 at 2409876575.
tilly_infra: Staging applied, smoke tests passed (latency within SLO). Rolling to prod in 3 minutes.
deploy-bot: prod deployment started at 2409876590, config cfg_gc_2409.
sam_gce: Seeing successful 120 qps for a 3 min burst, logs look normal. Thanks.
emma_cs: Please capture this in the renewal notes - customer is seeing launch traction in APAC, mark as low churn risk for next 30 days but note dependency on regional peering working smoothly.
ryan_ops: Done. Added note to acct_GC_9982: "APAC pilot - temporary rate bump and peering provisioned 2026-03-22 UTC; monitor for errors; auto-revoke in 48h."
emma_cs: Also sending an enablement checklist to liam: quick docs on header signing and retry guidance.
sam_gce: One follow-up: Can we add a telemetry tag for this burst so product can analyze token cost per session?
tilly_infra: Will add tag: goldcrest_apac_launch_240987.
emma_cs: Thanks all - keep channel posted and ping if rollback triggers. :party_parrot:
